notes.title: Hard mode is now developing & G-Star 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/20c8c8e6e0b4f4262b0d31ec8e7a3aad070e2603.png[/img]
Thanks to all the players who played the Revenant and loved it, 
we are going to G-Star 2023 in BEXCO, Busan
Thanks to you players, our team got the opportunity. Thanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/a976201d3d7c8b92762fed975f841f1316b94065.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/d3098e97753710963548a1d59c80c748985b29ab.png[/img]
Please refer to the top image for the location of the booth!
https://www.gstar.or.kr/

Throughout the exhibition, I felt that many people who enjoyed the Revenant increased their skills.

So, We're currently developing an additional hard mode! Hard mode includes content that was deleted during the development process.

 - Limited Bullet
 - Different level design in the lab stage
 - More system to the Alpha(Boss)

And more
 - Improved UI
 - Fixing Sprite animation bug

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/9ba17b7d7777d67d47ddf37323ab931aee31d66a.png[/img]

The additional patches will be updated on Steam after the G-Star exhibition. (Of course, it's free.)

Finally, last month, we launched Revenant not only through Steam but also through Stove Indie.
https://indie.onstove.com/ko/games/2450

Thanks!
